items.title: Manuel "Fess" Manetta Interview, 1957-03-21
items.q: It was on Howard. On Howard.

ctx.x: Well, did those things just happen occasionally, or was there... Once a week, maybe. Once a week, maybe. Oh, yeah, once a week. I guess it was about all the musicians played there, no? One time or not. Yeah, mostly around on Sunday nights. Yeah, mostly around on Sunday nights. Where was Tumley's place again? It was on Howard. On Howard.
Howard. That's the old one. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah.
